imgDesc.text: The objects that coexist with kuuvahki energy exist in three different states. Objects lacking kuuvahki exist in a <color=#ffe14b>Fallowed</color> state, those affected by the Abyss enter a <color=#ffe14b>Blighted</color> state, objects fully infused with kuuvahki will enter a <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> state. When these objects are in <color=#ffe14b>Fallowed</color> and <color=#ffe14b>Blighted</color> states, you are unable to obtain kuuvahki from them.

Kuuvahki that exists in its pure energetic form can propagate through currents.
Upon impact, objects that are <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> with kuuvahki will release a single <color=#ffe14b>kuuvahki current</color> , providing energy to other objects susceptible to kuuvahki within a certain range. These objects will then become <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> .
When necessary, hit <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> objects to release a single <color=#ffe14b>kuuvahki current</color> .
